description: Insert an inline image from a public URL or a local file (uploaded to Drive, embedded, then the temp upload removed). Position via at (top/end/or a unique text anchor), size via width/height (points), and align left/center/right. Set segment:"header" for a letterhead logo — that is where a repeating, correctly-sized logo belongs, and it is why a template’s logo is invisible to a body read. A direct edit, not a tracked suggestion. Note: floating/text-wrapped images are not supported by the Docs API.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

at.description: "top", "end", or a unique text snippet to insert after (default top)

baseDir.description: absolute dir to resolve a relative local `uri` against

createSegment.description: when segment is header/footer and the doc has none, create it first (the letterhead case). Only the default header/footer can be created via the API.

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

tab.description: Target a specific tab by tabId or title (from list_tabs). Defaults to the first tab.

uri.description: public image URL, or a path to a local image file (absolute, or relative to baseDir)

name: insert_image
title: Insert an image
